column3: “the surface of the land” renders “the eye of the land” (also in verse 11).
“I will indeed honor you richly” renders an emphatic doubled verb with “exceedingly.”
“contrary to the command of” renders “to transgress the mouth of.”
“I will find out” renders “let me know.”
“these three times” renders “these three feet (regalim)” (also in verses 32–33).
“you have made a mockery of me” renders “you have dealt wantonly with me.”
“Have I ever been accustomed” renders an emphatic doubled verb.
